capabilities: Read and open the source of today's daily note
Collect and check off tasks from the whole vault or selected folders
Show note counts, character totals and a 12–52 week writing heatmap
Browse past dates with a timeline and calendar
Customize avatar, image carousel, banner, palette and an optional audio visualizer
disambiguation: Not a daily-notes template creator; it displays existing daily notes, collected tasks and statistics on a dashboard rather than generating notes.
extras: Windows audio visualizer runs a hidden PowerShell process to read speaker output levels; audio is analyzed in memory only. Installs a Daily Desk Examples/ folder on first run. Previously named Alex Desk (same plugin ID). Donation links are voluntary and unlock no features. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7+, desktop only.
problem: Obsidian spreads daily notes, tasks and writing statistics across separate views, so there is no single local home page tying them together.
summary: Local dashboard plugin that gathers daily notes, vault-wide Markdown tasks, character counts, a writing heatmap and a date timeline on one customizable home page.
